title: 费德提克·稻原静影
description: 费德提克保留稻草木架与笼状躯干，直立于开阔田边，长镰刀刃朝下静放，清爽光线消除恐怖气氛。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Fiddlesticks is an asymmetrical scarecrow-like figure assembled from straw, dark timber, red cloth scraps, and a cage-like torso frame. Preserve the long articulated limbs, patched tilted head, and unmistakable nonhuman construction. Use a composed simplified face with no frightening open mouth or decaying anatomy. Its curved scythe is planted safely beside the body with the blade down, never raised.
art_direction.scene: Frame the entire stationary figure at the edge of a wide harvested field beneath a bright clear sky, long limbs separated and balanced over the ground. A distant barn is reduced to one simple geometric mass. Hard low sunlight makes straw and timber into angular wax-crayon strokes, with broad peaceful field shadows and no flock, chase, fog, or horror staging.
art_direction.palette: straw gold, weathered timber, faded crimson, blue sky
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
